name: docker-gen
description_en: Generate files from docker container meta-data
readme_excerpt: docker-gen docker-gen is a file generator that renders templates using docker container meta-data. It can be used to generate various kinds of files for: - Centralized logging - fluentd, logstash or other centralized logging tools that tail the containers JSON log file or files within the container. - Log Rotation - logrotate files to rotate container JSON log files - Reverse Proxy Configs - nginx, haproxy, etc. reverse proxy configs to route requests from the host to containers - Service Disco…
